name: crux-api
description: P0 persistence layer for Crux, against build/schema.sql

scripts.db:migrate: for s in ../migration/*.sql; do psql $DATABASE_URL -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f $s; done
scripts.db:gate: psql $DATABASE_URL -c 'select * from migration_gate' -c 'select * from migration_unaccounted' -c 'select * from migration_open_questions'
